_receta: Objeto deseado gigante (huevo, cofre, pez dorado) en el centro con rayos y brillo; el avatar lo levanta. Sirve para miniatura y, recortada, para ícono.
_valores: Boceto: hero = objeto, avatar = avatar levantándolo. Texto: label = 1-2 palabras (EPIC EGG). IA (en inglés): prize_desc, world_desc.

ia.prompt: In the center, {{prize_desc}}, gigantic, glowing and bursting with light rays and sparkles. Below it, {{AVATAR}} lifts it above their head with both arms, amazed (huge eyes, open mouth). Setting: {{world_desc}}, with radiant sunburst light behind the object. The object fills the center ~55% of the frame.
